# OpenKeys Copilot Instructions

- Follow OpenKeys_GitHub_Copilot_Brief.md as the product specification.
- Keep the app focused on live MIDI performance.
- Preserve the three voice slots: Right 1, Right 2, Left 1.
- Split is optional and configured per preset.
- Prioritize low-latency, stable audio and correct MIDI note routing.
- Do not include SoundFonts without verified redistribution rights.
- Make small, buildable changes and add tests for routing and preset logic.
- Do not modify unrelated files.
- Summarize changed files and validation results concisely.
